The everyday scrcpy options. Tap the title to show or hide them. All choices are remembered.
Every other scrcpy option. Tap the title to show or hide them, then tap a group to open it. Empty fields use the scrcpy default.
Share this phone over the internet (test)

Lets a phone anywhere connect to this one through Cloudflare: no account, same Wi-Fi not needed. Needs ADB over Wi-Fi (port 5555) on this phone. Tap Start, send the code to the other phone, paste it into its address box and tap Connect, then tap Allow on this phone. A new code every time.

Android only lets an app switch ADB to port 5555 with root. Without root, do it once from a computer (it stays on until the phone restarts):

1. Settings › About phone › tap Build number 7 times.
2. Developer options › turn on USB debugging.
3. Connect the phone by USB and run:
 adb tcpip 5555

Then tap Check here.

Phone Share can keep mirroring in a small floating window when you go Home or switch apps, like a YouTube popup player.\n\nFor that, Android needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission. Tap Go to settings and turn it on for Phone Share.

Bundled upstream server: v5.0.1. Audio needs Android 11 or newer on the target device. Desktop-only flags (recording, window settings, USB/OTG, HID keyboard/mouse) are not part of this Android viewer.
Choose a YouTube-style floating player or full-screen mirroring. Android may ask for permission to display over other apps.
Audio is on by default: the other device\'s sound plays on this phone. Turn it off to save data.
No control disables remote touch, key, wake-on-connect and turn-screen-off-on-connect commands. Power off on close remains a server cleanup option.
⭐ 480p is recommended: smoothest picture with the least delay and data, especially over mobile data or a share code. Pick a higher size only on fast Wi-Fi.
Recommended: 480p, 1 Mbps, 30 fps, H.264, audio on both devices.
